{{Quote|Lagret's brother is… is stationed on Scarif. He's made comments. Nothing definitive, but—|Dedra Meero, while being interrogated by Orson Krennic regarding who knew about the Death Star|audio=LagretsBrother.flac|<ref name="Who Else Knows?" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] individual who lived during the [[Imperial Era]] was the '''brother''' of<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> the [[human]] male<ref name="Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> [[captain]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Lagret]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Lagret's brother also worked for the Empire,<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> and by [[1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY">{{AndorDate|211}}</ref> he was stationed on<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Scarif]].<ref name="Who Else Knows?" />

After [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] learned that [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] had unauthorized access to classified information pertaining to the [[Project Stardust|construction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], Krennic interrogated Meero, demanding to know who else knew about the [[Death Star]]. Meero speculated that, due to past comments made, Lagret's brother could have potentially acquired knowledge of the station, up until then a closely-kept secret even within Imperial bureaucracy<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> under the guise of the [[Galactic Emperor]]'s [[Project Celestial Power|Energy Initiative]].<ref name="One Year Later">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lagret's brother was mentioned in "[[Who Else Knows?]]," the eleventh episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
